You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From c57cd3c89ecf2812976f53e494580a396f93efd2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Suthikulpanit, Suravee" <Suravee.Suthikulpanit@amd.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jan 2019 08:09:46 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] svm: Fix improper check when deactivate AVIC
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The function svm_refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl() always returning prematurely
as kvm_vcpu_apicv_active() always return false when calling from
the function arch/x86/kvm/x86.c:kvm_vcpu_deactivate_apicv().
This is because the apicv_active is set to false just before calling
refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl().

Also, we need to mark VMCB_AVIC bit as dirty instead of VMCB_INTR.

So, fix svm_refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl() to properly deactivate AVIC.

Fixes: 67034bb9dd5e ('KVM: SVM: Add irqchip_split() checks before enabling AVIC')
Cc: Radim Krčmář <rkrcmar@redhat.com>
Cc: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Suravee Suthikulpanit <suravee.suthikulpanit@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
---
 arch/x86/kvm/svm.c | 10 +++++-----
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/arch/x86/kvm/svm.c b/arch/x86/kvm/svm.c
index 01b66bbcdd7a..74ceda470eae 100644
--- a/arch/x86/kvm/svm.c
+++ b/arch/x86/kvm/svm.c
@@ -5122,11 +5122,11 @@ static void svm_refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl(struct kvm_vcpu *vcpu)
 	struct vcpu_svm *svm = to_svm(vcpu);
 	struct vmcb *vmcb = svm->vmcb;
 
-	if (!kvm_vcpu_apicv_active(&svm->vcpu))
-		return;
-
-	vmcb->control.int_ctl &= ~AVIC_ENABLE_MASK;
-	mark_dirty(vmcb, VMCB_INTR);
+	if (kvm_vcpu_apicv_active(vcpu))
+		vmcb->control.int_ctl |= AVIC_ENABLE_MASK;
+	else
+		vmcb->control.int_ctl &= ~AVIC_ENABLE_MASK;
+	mark_dirty(vmcb, VMCB_AVIC);
 }
 
 static void svm_load_eoi_exitmap(struct kvm_vcpu *vcpu, u64 *eoi_exit_bitmap)
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an improper check in the function `svm_refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl()`, which was returning prematurely because the function `kvm_vcpu_apicv_active()` always returned false when called from `kvm_vcpu_deactivate_apicv()`. This was due to the `apicv_active` being set to false just before the call to `refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl()`, preventing the correct handling of the AVIC (Advanced Virtual Interrupt Controller) state. Additionally, the code was incorrectly marking the `VMCB_INTR` bit as dirty instead of the `VMCB_AVIC` bit, which was necessary for proper state management.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was an improper check in the function `svm_refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl()`, which was returning prematurely because the function `kvm_vcpu_apicv_active()` always returned false when called from `kvm_vcpu_deactivate_apicv()`. This was due to the `apicv_active` being set to false just before the call to `refresh_apicv_exec_ctrl()`, preventing the correct handling of the AVIC (Advanced Virtual Interrupt Controller) state. Additionally, the code was incorrectly marking the `VMCB_INTR` bit as dirty instead of the `VMCB_AVIC` bit, which was necessary for proper state management.
